isabel_runtime_strategy.first_pass: Run Unreal + Pixel Streaming on Arc B390 before purchasing eGPU hardware
isabel_runtime_strategy.egpu_upgrade_path: OCuLink external NVIDIA GPU if measured render/encode headroom is insufficient

decision_rule: Do not recommend OCuLink/NVIDIA purchase until the Arc B390 has been measured in the actual Isabel office scene with character, lighting, four screens, voice, and Pixel Streaming active.
